//: Gzipped ceilings for every published bundle, in bytes. Read by scripts/check-size.mjs in CI. Raising a number is a deliberate edit with a reason in the commit message, not silent drift. The core ceiling is set so the documented '~9kb' stays true: 9600 bytes is 9.4KB, which still rounds to 9; past 9700 the claim needs rewording, not just a bigger budget. Headroom is a few percent by design — enough that ordinary work does not trip it, tight enough that a real feature is a conversation.
//devtools: The devtools ceiling is looser than the others on purpose. This bundle is development-only and never loads in production, so its bytes cost a visitor nothing — and the panel's usability is the entire reason it exists. Raised from 5600 to 6000 when docking landed, to leave room for the panel to keep improving rather than making every UI change a budget negotiation.
